A few young fiddleheads curl on the left. Every frond leans to the right; the big ones sweep out and droop at the tips, so the plant looks combed to one side. The fronds meet at a narrow, dark base at the bottom left of centre. There is no soil, rock or shadow. It is painterly and illustrative, with a soft dark outline and moderate detail. It looks very much like an ordinary Earth fern, something like a Polystichum or Dryopteris shield fern.

At max zoom the fern sits in its cell next to the vanilla human and stands about two-thirds of the human's height, roughly waist to chest high. Its base is in the lower part of the cell and the fronds spread to the right. At 32 px per cell it still reads as a small green feathery tuft that leans one way. Zoomed out it becomes a green speck. request.subject: RM_Shadefern

edits.change: The fronds are blade-like and subtly ribbed: each pinna is a narrow, fused, ribbed blade joined to its neighbours along the base. The frond edges are smooth with fine parallel veins, and the outline is not a serrated Earth-fern leaflet. The tips taper into a slender curved point.
The foliage has a cold blue-black undertone in the shadowed folds, within the deep green. The pale rachis is faintly luminous, as if it holds the bounced light.

The young growth is a flat, tightly folded blade that unrolls straight, not a spiral fiddlehead. The branching is irregular and asymmetric, with a few long blades split from the rachis at uneven intervals.
Every frond is swept to one side as if combed, and all the blades lean the same way off the pale rachis.

invariants: deep-green palette with a cold blue-black undertone
pale rachis on every frond
every frond swept to the same side, as if combed
fern-like clump form growing from one base
single plant, transparent background
painterly vanilla RimWorld style, clean dark outline
request.prompt: A single RimWorld plant sprite: Shadefern, a low clump of alien stone-shade fern, seen from above at a slight angle, centred, on a transparent background. Deep-green fronds with a cold blue-black undertone in the shadowed folds grow from one small base. Each frond has a slender, faintly luminous pale rachis that catches bounced light. Off the rachis, the frond is made of long, narrow, ribbed blades, with fine parallel veins, smooth edges and tapering curved tips. The blades are fused along their bases, so each frond reads as a single comb-like vane, and the branching is uneven, with a few long blades split off at irregular intervals. New growth is a flat, tightly folded blade that unrolls straight. Every frond in the clump is swept to the same side, as if combed in one direction, so the whole plant leans cold-side. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, soft shading, clean dark outline, small sprite readable at about 0.7 tile. Reference: none; build the plant from this description.
